Customer chat: conversations, messages, people and visitors of one Crisp workspace.

## API key

1. Open [docs.crisp.chat](https://docs.crisp.chat/guides/rest-api/authentication/website-token/) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** A website token, which the workspace owner generates under Settings > Workspace Settings > Advanced configuration > API Token.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add crisp
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  crisp: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Crisp's [API](https://docs.crisp.chat/references/rest-api/v1/) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show crisp` shows the key as set.

**Rate limits:** 10000 a day. The website token's daily quota.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Crisp).
